changes: Wanted now explains when existing missing backlog is paused by Continuous Automation settings and links directly to the relevant setup.
SAB-backed Active downloads retain bounded presentation ownership across longer transient queue-slot gaps while real byte progress or foreground activity proves the transfer is continuing.
Remove and Cancel require SAB queue absence before NewzDeck hides the card or records an explicit removal tombstone, preventing hidden transfers that continue consuming bandwidth.
Existing explicit removal tombstones that still point to a live SAB job are reconciled by reissuing the user stop/delete intent.
Automatic season packs are fallback-only: individual episodes are searched first, partially complete seasons never trigger a full pack, and packs cannot overlap active member episodes.
Diagnostics reports Active-card continuity bridges and hidden-transfer cleanup activity.
regression_guards: The Active continuity lease is bounded and cannot override explicit pause, propagation retry, terminal history, or a different foreground package.
A failed or unconfirmed SAB Remove/Cancel keeps the NewzDeck ownership record visible and returns an error instead of creating a hidden transfer.
Season packs are generated only for fully aired seasons whose monitored episodes are all missing and whose individual searches have returned no acceptable release.
A queued season pack reserves all member episode targets for the remainder of the Automation cycle.
v3.6.12 installer-owned runtime restore, v3.6.11 SAB ownership/Smart Import continuity, and v3.6.10 Python source-freshness protections remain preserved.
name: Download Continuity & Automation Clarity
